title: Release new version v0.1.1 and trigger GitHub Actions release workflow

requirements.description: Desktop menu icon and launcher: Deploy multi-size icons, pixmaps, absolute icon path in phimbop.desktop, and reload desktop databases
Tray ID isolation & crash prevention: Isolate tray ID to phimbop-tray, wrap setup in catch_unwind, set WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER, and verify Rust checks
Universal installer script: Support --native flag, ensure proper CLI flag precedence (--deb/--appimage), and rate-limit proof release fetching
Release version bump: Bump version to v0.1.1 across package.json, tauri.conf.json, and workspace crates
